verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships an official JS/TS SDK, documented as a type-safe client for building integrations and controlling opencode programmatically against its headless server. A live OpenAPI spec backs that server, giving users a documented surface to build against. missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond JS/TS, in-depth SDK reference evidence (methods, events, versioning), independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The opencode JS/TS SDK provides a type-safe client for interacting with the server. Use it to build integrations and control opencode programmatically.
The opencode serve command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://opencode.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
